messages:
Olivia Hart: FYI NordicPay (SMB) dropped to near-zero activity after initial import step. Renewal in 24 days. Thinking a compact 'bridge & enable' save to avoid churn. Open for quick sync?

Marcus Lee: Can we get the funnel? Where are they falling off?

Tanya Kim: Onboarding metrics: 70% finished setup, but only 12% reach week-2 usage. Most fail during multi-file ingest -> vectorize. They also hit sharp token spikes from retries.

Devon Park: Telemetry: client retries + 400s on large multipart uploads (>9MB). No infra 5xx. Suggest temporary rate-limit and smaller max payload to stop retry storms.

Olivia Hart: Proposed compact play: 1) 15-min triage call 2) Apply temporary bridge plan (rate-limit + preserve model pins/audit) 3) 30-min enablement demo on streaming/prefix-cache 4) 72-hr watch + snapshot 5) Renewal update. Owner: @Tanya.

Marcus Lee: Bridge plan idea: "bridge-rate-limit" — keep API keys & model versions, reduce concurrency & token throughput, price discount for 30 days. Reversible via single API. Add rollback instructions.

Devon Park: Quick ops snippet to apply org-scoped safety: ```json
{"org_id":"nordicpay","bridge_plan":"bridge-rate-limit","max_concurrency":2,"max_file_mb":6,"enable_prefix_cache":true}
``` I'll stage this and run smoke.

Tanya Kim: Outreach blurb for invite: "Hi {{name}}, we saw import failures and can do a 15-min triage + one config change that usually fixes this. Tomorrow 10am PT?"

Olivia Hart: Can someone make a 1-paragraph note for renewals outlining what we changed and that it's reversible? Keep it <5 bullets.

Marcus Lee: I'll draft the renewals note: cause, action taken (bridge + enablement), rollback path, success metrics (import success >95%, WAU +25% in 7 days), next steps.

cs-bot: Ticket CS-9804 created for NordicPay activation rescue. Priority: P3. Assigned: Devon Park.

Devon Park: Pushed safety config to staging; smoke tests (100 synthetic imports at new caps) passed. Ready to push after triage call.

Tanya Kim: After demo we'll capture: pre/post import success screenshot, whether prefix cache was previously enabled, and quick customer feedback. Tag play: bridge-enable-slim.

Olivia Hart: Timeline: triage tomorrow 10am PT, prod change within 3 hours post-call if agreed, 72-hr snapshot, renewals update 7 days before renewal. If this stabilizes we'll formalize the play and add a canned workflow in CS toolkit. :sparkles:
